title: plugingen.json
description: Which operations of a provider's OpenAPI document a plugin calls. plugingen generates src/api-types.gen.ts from them.

oneOf.description: A provider with several documents. Each writes src/api-types.<name>.gen.ts.

specUrl.description: Where the provider publishes the document (JSON or YAML, OpenAPI 3 or Swagger 2).

pathPrefix.description: A version prefix the document writes into every path, where the client's base URL has to hold it. Paths outside it are dropped, and `paths` and `patches` are written without it.

paths.description: The operations the plugin calls. Everything else is left out of the generated types.

patches.description: Overwrite one value of the document, before anything else runs, where it is wrong or too strict for what the plugin sends. A patch that no longer changes anything, or whose parent has gone, fails the run.

pointer.description: A JSON pointer into the document in its OpenAPI 3 form: `/` in a name is `~1`, `~` is `~0`, and percent-encoding is decoded. A Swagger 2 `definitions` schema is at `/components/schemas`.

why.description: Why the document is wrong here.
